findings.title: Verify 字源 scan finding for 672C
findings.details: [OCR CORRECTION REQUIRED] 字源, 李學勤主編《字源》 (2012), PDF p. 516 / printed p. 503, 本 headword passage after 《说文》: raw OCR span “《说文》：“木下日本。””; scan pixels show “《说文》：“木下曰本。””. This is a source-bound OCR transcription error; proposed literal replacement is 曰, not applied to the corpus.
